pages.text: You have found one of the rare disks. There are four, never sold in shops and never crafted: they turn up in old chests, and in the chest of a ham shack (a little house with a J-pole on the roof, out in the country or in a village).$(br2)Install them like any other disk; the disk is not used up, so pass it round.

pages.title: Snake
pages.text: $(thing)SNAKE$(): eat, grow, and do not bite your own tail. Arrows or WASD steer, P pauses. The ten best scores on each computer are kept on its disk ($(thing)SNAKE.DAT$()).

pages.title: Pileup
pages.text: $(thing)PILEUP$(): callers fall into the band. Fill a row edge to edge to work them: a QSO, and the row leaves the band. Every 8 QSOs you move up a band, from 160m to 70cm, and it gets faster. Left/Right move, Up turns, Down drops, Space slams.

pages.title: Music Player
pages.text: $(thing)MUSIC$(): forty-six tunes, Joplin and Bach to chiptune, jazz, rock and RPG themes, on the computer's sound card and its small, tinny speakers. Only you hear it, at your master and jukebox volume. It plays on in other programs (the note in the top bar brings it back) and after $(thing)Close$() (C), fading as you walk away; it stops past 24 blocks, in another dimension, or when the computer loses power. Enter plays, Space pauses, S stops, the Left and Right arrows go back and on, R repeats one, H shuffles (every tune once before any comes again).

pages.title: Bible
pages.text: $(thing)BIBLE$(): the four gospels of the World English Bible (public domain). Left and Right turn the chapter; F3 goes to a verse (John 3:16), F4 picks a book and chapter, F5 finds verses with every word you type.
